meta.title: Imaging sources of the spine projects (CTSpinoPelvic1K, SchwingNet, spine-detector)
meta.generator: scratchpad dataplan/platform/build_sources.py from the five family card files, ranking.csv and disk_map.csv

families.A: CT releases the project was built on, their nnU-Net datasets and CT render banks
families.B: Anomaly-harvest CT acquisitions (acquisition census, NLST pilot, validation set)
families.C: Real X-ray and fluoroscopy with 3-D truth or pose
families.D: Plain-film and harvested 2-D corpora and their banks
families.E: Disk map of HOME and Ceph (locations only)

user_vars.PHYSIONET_USER: the PhysioNet account of the named person who signed the VinDr-SpineXR DUA (supplied at run time; never stored)

notes: Every structured value is copied from a card in DATA_MANIFEST.md; the 'cite' lists are the citations of the card field it came from. 'not recorded' means no file on disk says it.
Sizes in locations are dated by their size_basis and are not additive across dates.

defects: **0533.** The published CT was truncated: 17,301,504 B, sha256 `20e673dc…d6e23`. It was rebuilt to 250,067,995 B, sha256 `478a74e9…a164d5`, (512,577,512) PIR (KI §10; AUDIT L1345-L1353). The HF object was replaced 2026-09-23 (mem:grid-ct-0533-truncated.md). The KNOWN_ISSUES §10 note is not yet on Zenodo (mem:grid-ct-0533-truncated.md).
**HF labels are still v10.** Id 29 is live on HF as of 2026-09-27; Zenodo is v11 (AUDIT L295-L298, L913; mem:hf-mirror-is-v10.md).
mem:hf-mirror-is-v10.md says v11 "exists only locally / on the grid".
AUDIT L615 (Zenodo API read) and CRC L332-L333 say Zenodo v11 is public.
The card follows the API read.
**Wrong manifest column.** `manifest.n_voxels_fg` is 0 in 340 of 802 records, and 2,094,598 for 0533 against 3,167,246 in the mask (AUDIT L1368-L1373, L922; KI §10).
**Undocumented measure.** `spine_bone_pct` is measured over vertebra ids only, and nothing says so (KI §10; AUDIT L1355-L1366).
**`croissant.json` is listed in the README but exists in neither deposit** (AUDIT L647, L914).
**Split key trap.** `splits_5fold.json` is keyed by TCIA token, not `volume_id`. 529 of 802 token ids collide with another record's volume_id (AUDIT L915, L926).
**Three different "transitional" counts** in the release: 31 / 33 / 34 (AUDIT L923).
**Token ≠ release id** (release 0145 = token 100) (mem:identity-audit-findings.md).

- CTSpinoPelvic1K, HuggingFace export finalized 2026-04-25; manifests redrawn 1 May (CRC L193, L327-L329).
